# meilisearch_index_settings (Data Source)

Reads selected core settings from an existing Meilisearch index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meilisearch_index_settings" "example" {
  index_uid = "index-settings-example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_uid` (String) UID of the existing Meilisearch index.

### Read-Only

- `displayed_attributes` (List of String) Attributes returned in search results.
- `distinct_attribute` (String) Attribute used to deduplicate search results.
- `filterable_attributes` (Set of String) Attributes available to filtering. Advanced filterable rules are unsupported.
- `id` (String) Remote index UID.
- `ranking_rules` (List of String) Ranking rules in evaluation order.
- `searchable_attributes` (List of String) Searchable attributes in priority order.
- `sortable_attributes` (Set of String) Attributes available to sorting.
- `stop_words` (Set of String) Stop words ignored during search.
- `synonyms` (Map of List of String) Synonym groups keyed by their source term.
